notes.subject: מפני שמן
notes.rationale: 'Ka baka la mafura': KJV 'because of the anointing', ASV/JPS 'because of fatness', YLT 'because of prosperity', BSB 'neck grown too large' — šemén ke mafura ka bobedi, tlhalo ga e ape.

notes.subject: על / על
notes.rationale: Go boela ga lentšu 'joko' ka pedi (ya sehla sa bobedi go le ka moono) — go gateleta go tloša ga bokgoba, go bolokilwe ka go boela ga lona.

notes.subject: go Yuda/Yerushalayime
notes.rationale: 'Sehukeng sa gago… molaleng wa gago' — temana e bolela le mootledi ka botšišo, setšhaba se lebišwa ka leina la motho.

translation: Gomme go tla ba mo letšatšing leo, morwalo wa gagwe o tla tlošwa mo sehukeng sa gago, le joko ya gagwe mo molaleng wa gago; gomme joko e tla roba ka baka la mafura.
